name: Product Card
summary: Product listing card with media, title, vendor, badges, price area, and optional quick-add composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Product card container composed on the same article as the canonical Card root.

anatomy.name: primaryImage
anatomy.description: Primary image when a hover image is also present.

anatomy.name: badges
anatomy.description: Badge stack for sale, new, or availability labels.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Footer area for price and secondary actions.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid card size controlled by the parent grid.

states.name: hoverImage
states.description: Alternate image reveal and primary image scale on fine-pointer hover or keyboard focus within the card.

states.name: quickAddVisible
states.description: Quick-add becomes visible on fine-pointer hover and keyboard focus within the card.

states.name: coarsePointerAction
states.description: Quick-add remains persistently visible when hover is absent or the primary pointer is coarse.

states.name: titleFocusVisible
states.description: The stretched title link produces a visible card-sized focus indicator.

behavior.name: canonicalCardComposition
behavior.description: The root article consumes canonical Card surface, border, radius, shadow, overflow, and lift behavior instead of recreating them.

behavior.name: navigation
behavior.description: One descriptive title link is stretched across the passive card content; media is not a second link and separately interactive descendants remain above the stretched hit area.

behavior.name: quickAdd
behavior.description: Optional quick-add composes Button, remains reachable by keyboard and coarse pointers, includes product context in its accessible name when repeated, and delegates mutation and validation to the target product workflow.

behavior.name: pricing
behavior.description: Price formatting should be delegated to the Price dependency.

behavior.name: mediaRatio
behavior.description: One bounded semantic ratio applies to the complete passive media region; square is the default and portrait uses the shared 3:4 portrait proportion without exposing arbitrary numeric ratios.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible product title and accessible name of the single product-detail link.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Product-detail destination used by the title link.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.description: Alternative text for the primary product image.

properties.name: mediaRatio
properties.description: Shared semantic media proportion used consistently by Product Card collections; square maps to 1:1 and portrait maps to the established 3:4 portrait proportion.

properties.name: hoverImage
properties.description: Optional alternate media revealed by hover or focus-within.

properties.name: quickAddAction
properties.description: Optional Button composition for quick add.

accessibility: Use one descriptive product-title link as the card navigation target; keep media passive and do not add a redundant image link.
Give the primary product image descriptive alternative text when it adds information; alternate hover imagery for the same product uses empty alternative text.
Keep separately interactive descendants above the stretched title-link hit area and preserve their native focus and activation behavior.
Keep quick add visible without hover on coarse pointers and include product context in its accessible name when cards repeat.
Expose a visible card-sized focus indicator for the stretched title link and stop decorative transitions under reduced motion.
Badges and sale information should be exposed as text, not only color.

shopify.notes: The product-card snippet maps Shopify product data to canonical Card, Badge, Button, Price, media, title-link, and quick-add anatomy.
